arabic text:
Hai baba mar gaya hai, shabbar o shabbier ka
Gham Ali ki betiyon ke phir se taaza hogaye, daagh
qaayim tha jigar mein, madar e dilgeer ka
Fatema zehra ke marqad se sada aane lagi, ye
masayeb reh gaya tha kya meri taqdeer ka
Baap ki Mayyat se Zainab Ka Lipatna baar baar, hai
lipatna baar baar, dil hila deta hia noha, khwahare
shabbier ka
Naza mein jaane Ali ko kya khayal ata raha, kya
khayal ata raha, mun khabhi zainab ka dekha, aur
kabhi shabbier ka
Thapkiyan dete rahe hazrat kabhi abbas ko, hai kabhi
abbas ko, aur bazu chumte the chand si tasweer ka
Betiyon ko dekhte hai aur rote hai ali, haaye wo
zaalim tasavvur shaam ki tash-heer ka
english translation text:
Baba has died—the father of Shabbar and Shabbir.
The grief of Ali's daughters has become fresh again; the wound
within the grieving mother's heart had never healed.
From Fatima Zahra's grave a voice began to rise:
Was this calamity also left within my destiny?
Zainab repeatedly clung to her father's bier—
again and again she clung; the lament of Shabbir's sister
shook every heart.
Who knows what thoughts came to Ali in his final moments?
What thoughts came to him? At times he looked at Zainab's face,
and at times at Shabbir's.
He gently patted Abbas, again and again,
and kissed the arms of that moonlike child.
Ali looked towards his daughters and wept—alas,
he foresaw their public humiliation in Shaam.
